title: Live outside acceptance runs on orphan base branches of a repository the App reaches
body:
Why: t-d19z692 is blocked on repo creation (t-nhz6nn6, d-174575). Fable 1114 review: run the live acceptance now on a repository the App already reaches. The lead chose krn-works/krn itself (our repo; never an operator project repo).
Outcome: scratch copies /mnt/storage/tmp/krn-outside/{php,npm,py} pushed as orphan base branches outside/php, outside/npm, outside/py of krn-works/krn; krn adopt, first-test PR via krn lane run and a drain of one real task run against real GitHub PRs targeting those bases; branches deleted afterwards.
Proof: three graded rows in .krn/runs/outside/summary.txt with zero lead turns; any non-default-base gap in lane run/pr ship is fixed with a regression test.
